title: Scoring
intro: How much each part of an Offer counts when Boba ranks it. Saving creates a new preferences version, and your open Offers are re-scored with it.
version.hint: Every change to your weights creates a new version, so Boba knows which scores are out of date.
stale: Scores are out of date: your weights changed. Offers are re-scored on the next run.
saved: Weights saved. Open Offers are re-scored with the new version.

fit.title: Fit weights
fit.hint: How much each answer counts toward whether you can get the job.

quality.title: Quality weights
quality.hint: How much each answer counts toward whether you want the job.

axes.title: Fit vs Quality
axes.hint: How the two sides combine into the Rank. The two are rebalanced to 100 together.

error.load: Boba could not read your weights.
error.save: Boba could not save your weights.
error.range: Every weight must be a whole number between 0 and 100.
error.axis: Each side needs at least one weight above zero, and Fit and Quality can't both be zero.

embeddings.title: On-device semantic match
embeddings.hint: Boba can compare each Offer's meaning with your Profile using a small language model that runs on this device. The download is about {size} MB, once, and nothing about your search leaves your computer. Without it, the fit score skips this factor and spreads its weight over the others.
embeddings.loading: Checking whether the model is on this device…
embeddings.unavailable: This build of Boba has no on-device model, so the semantic match is unavailable. Everything else works as usual.
embeddings.on: Semantic match is on. It runs on this device and offline.
embeddings.downloading: Downloading and checking the model… this can take a few minutes.
embeddings.error: Boba could not change the semantic-match setting.
